rationale: The write-up never names the source paper or calls the method a reproduction; it only vaguely alludes to 'prior steering of this kind' using a five-layer band and frames the whole piece as a new contribution. The closing message explicitly names 'white-bear (raman2026)', states the submitted direction literally is that paper's direction, and candidly flags that only the localisation/characterisation (not the vector) is novel — disclosing more about the source and the limits of the method's novelty than the write-up does.
